summary: The root يقن (yqn) primarily means to know something with certainty or to be sure of it. It implies a deep, intuitive, or inferential understanding, similar to "to ascertain" or "to verify."
lane: 1 يَقِنَهُ ذ , (S, Msb, K,) and يَقِنَ بِهِ ; (Msb;) and , (S, K,) and بِهِ ; (K;) and ; and , (S, Msb, K,) and بِهِ ; (K;) all signify the same; (S;) He knew it; he was, or became, certain, or sure, or he made sure, of it; syn. عَلِمَهُ ; (Msb, K;) intuitively, and inferentially; (Msb;) [see 1 in art. علم ;] and تَحَقَقَّهُ . (K.)
